title: New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid and Western Massachusetts Electric Company (WMECO) file petition to construct & operate new overhead 115-kV overhead transmission line, and ancillary facilities, in the towns of Hampden, Palmer and Monson, Massachusetts, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §.69J
petitioner: New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: the Company hereby provides the Siting Board with a draft of the notification package to be sent to property owners once construction is complete in their vicinity.

Providing a pre-construction compliance filing in connection with NEP’s retirement of the Hampden #524 Substation addressing the requirements to provide a diesel equipment certification (Condition F), a waste management plan (Condition H), and a certified cost estimate (Condition I).
